editorial:
Imagine moving your family to a quiet town for a fresh start, only to find out your backyard is next to a road where trucks fly by at crazy speeds. You play along with the Creeds, a nice family who just wants peace, but things get weird when they meet their neighbor, Jud. He shows them a hidden burial ground that supposedly brings things back to life. It starts out as a small experiment with a pet cat, but the vibe quickly shifts from a cozy family drama to a total nightmare. You can really feel the tension building as the father makes choices that no sane person would ever make.

The acting is great, especially the way the kids look genuinely scared. While some of the old-school effects look a bit fake now, they actually add to the creepy feel of the film. The pacing is steady, and the twists will definitely make you cringe. If you love stories about grief and bad decisions, you need to see this.
endingExplained: After Louis brings his son Gage back from the dead, the boy returns as a murderous monster. Louis tries to kill him again, but his wife Rachel comes home and gets attacked. Gage kills Rachel, and then Louis finally manages to kill Gage for good. In a last act of desperation, Louis buries Rachel in the cemetery. She comes back as a zombie and scares Louis one last time before killing him in the final scene.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves old school horror and spooky stories about cemeteries.
